description: This source file provides utility functions for managing repository paths, analyzing TypeScript source files, and inventory diffing within a codebase. It includes functions for normalizing paths, resolving module specifiers, visiting module imports/exports in source files, comparing inventory entries, and performing inventory checks.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Converts an absolute file path into a relative repository path, using forward slashes.

methods.name: resolveRepoSpecifier
methods.description: Resolves module specifiers to repository-relative paths, considering relative and absolute specifiers.

methods.name: visitModuleSpecifiers
methods.description: Walks through a TypeScript source file AST to find import, export, and dynamic import declarations, invoking a callback for each.

methods.name: diffInventoryEntries
methods.description: Compares expected and actual inventory entries and returns missing and unexpected entries.

methods.name: writeLine
methods.description: Writes a line of text to a stream, appending a newline.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptInventory
methods.description: Reads multiple TypeScript files and collects their entries into an inventory, sorting the results.

methods.name: runBaselineInventoryCheck
methods.description: Performs an inventory comparison check against stored baseline data, outputting differences.
